title: Another course invites reflection

captions.physics: Speaking of a hoped-for unhurried continuation
captions.energy: Responding to changed conditions for conversation
captions.emotions: Feeling a need to consider words

meaning: You can speak of a hoped-for unhurried continuation and respond to changed conditions, feeling a need to consider what was heard without an immediate compulsory conclusion.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Star in the physical position appears in speaking of a hoped-for unhurried continuation. The Wheel of Fortune in energy supports willingness to respond to changed conditions and stay connected to the exchange’s actual course. The Hermit in emotions brings a need to consider what was heard. You can hope for a long conversation and discover important meaning in another form. A brief exchange determines neither depth of interest nor the speed of an inward answer.

Suppose rain prevents a walk during which you intended to talk. A short call remains possible, and you discuss one precious thought instead of the whole subject. **A changed form does not determine the value of what was heard**. Afterwards, you may want to consider an explanation that unexpectedly connected many things. This response can be named directly without a complete conclusion immediately. Hope for further conversation remains although the earlier conditions did not work out and nobody has promised another available time.

Difficulty arises if quiet reflection after a brief exchange is treated as proof of insignificance. Words are urgently added to restore a sense of sufficient participation. The constructive Wheel of Fortune helps consider the actual changed conditions and the reply already given. You can value a short exchange and leave understanding time; continuation need neither immediately compensate for the missed walk nor turn personal reflection into a compulsory detailed report.
